source: Bank of Canada raised the target for the overnight rate to 2.50% on 2026-10-28, with the Bank Rate at 2.75% and the deposit rate at 2.45% (https://www.bankofcanada.ca/2026/10/fad-press-release-2026-10-28/). The previous target was held at 2.25% on 2026-09-02 (https://www.bankofcanada.ca/2026/09/fad-press-release-2026-09-02/). Valet series V39079 printed 2.25 on 2026-10-28 and 2.50 from 2026-10-29 through 2026-11-05 (https://www.bankofcanada.ca/valet/observations/V39079/json?recent=15). prime_rate 4.70 is this file's policy rate plus 2.20, last resolved as policy_plus_spread on 2026-10-30. The Bank of Canada does not publish prime. The previous lender figure recorded here was RBC Royal Bank prime 4.450% (https://www.rbcroyalbank.com/mortgages/mortgage-rates.html, checked 2026-09-27).
note: Big 5 prime on this site is the BoC policy rate plus 2.20. TD publishes a separate mortgage prime; the last figure recorded here for that mortgage prime was 4.60%. boc_policy_rate is the October 28, 2026 target of 2.50%. prime_rate 4.70 was resolved as policy plus spread on 2026-10-30 and is not a new lender press release. scraping/src/historical_rates.py refreshes the value from the BoC Valet API (policy series V39079 plus spread_over_policy) when that series is recent. The chartered-bank prime series V122495 is stale (last observations in 2019) and is used only if it is recent and prime − policy ≈ 2.20. Do not hard-code 5.45.
